User is a faculty member serving as the Associate Director of the URI Honors Program. The user is requesting assistance with offboarding an employee whose last day of employment is 5/15/2026.

The user’s primary concern is ensuring continuity of access to work-related Google Drive content by transferring ownership of the departing employee’s Google documents and other relevant Google Workspace files to a remaining staff member within the department, so that workflow is not disrupted following the employee’s departure.

The user is a incoming freshman running into an issue for the housing portal. They get the error “Login to Star Rez portal failed please try logging in again.” The user has the URI My Housing app in azure. Tried to login to the portal through safari and google chrome, but ran into the same issue. We also ran into the same issue when going through incognito windows. 

We are writing this ticket to grant the user access to URI My Housing.
